description: A large, roofless ruined temple hall of mossy stone brick, with collapsed colonnades, vine-draped standing archways, and a decorative blue-and-white glazed-terracotta floor medallion at its heart. An overgrown Mediterranean/Greek ruin that works as a dungeon approach, a shrine, or a boss arena.

style_fit.rationale: The strongest Mediterranean-ruin fit of the batch: mossy stonework, broken arches, and a glazed medallion give an immediate wow-moment. Largest footprint (15x24) of the round, roofless so it stays sky-lit, and renders with full fidelity at 1.21.11.
